sheet.savedWall: Saved · wallpaper updates in a few seconds
sheet.saveFailWall: Saved, but the wallpaper wasn't updated: {{reason}}

home.syncOff: Sync off · the desktop keeps its wallpaper
home.captionDone: City info added to the wallpaper
home.pinRateHint: Each new place is fetched live, so change it sparingly.
home.locationPlaceholder: City name, coordinates, or a map link
home.invalidLocation: No matching city — try coordinates, e.g. 51.5074, -0.1278.

general.gameDescOn: Guess the country or region of each day's city; it's revealed when you're done.
general.gameDescOff: Each day's city is shown right away.
general.gameTomorrow: Today's city is already revealed — guessing starts tomorrow.
general.gameOffBody: Each day's city will show right away. Turn the game back on any time; it starts the next day.
general.gameOffForfeit: Today's game will count as a loss.
general.quitDesc: No status bar icon to quit from.
general.wallpaperCacheDesc: macOS keeps a copy of each wallpaper and may never clear them, so this can reach gigabytes. The files inside can be deleted.
general.autoUpdateDesc: Installs new versions on this schedule and restarts, without asking.
general.updateUnavailable: Update server unavailable, try again later

proxy.label: Proxy
proxy.desc: For networks that can't reach OpenStreetMap or GitHub directly. Supports http:// and socks5://.
proxy.systemNone: No system proxy is set; connecting directly.
proxy.systemFromLinux: from the environment or GNOME settings
proxy.bad: Start with http://, https:// or socks5://, then a host
proxy.testNeedsUrl: Enter a valid address to test it

style.cityLabelHint: A daily city shows once it's guessed; a customized place shows its coordinates.

lab.intro: Experimental — may be buggy or not work.
lab.waterHint: Rivers, lakes and sea, lightly tinted.

about.tagline: A new city every day, drawn in ink.
about.feedbackDesc: Report a bug or share an idea on GitHub. Include your OS version, and the city and date if relevant.
about.logsDesc: Attach the log when reporting a bug.
about.osmAttribution: Road map data © <0>OpenStreetMap</0> contributors, licensed under <1>ODbL</1>.
about.geonamesAttribution: City list from <0>GeoNames</0>, licensed under <1>CC BY 4.0</1>.
about.designCredit: App icon and map visual design by {{name}}

devMode.advancePreviewDesc: Render an upcoming day into the daily cache. Today's wallpaper stays as it is.
devMode.cleanCacheDesc: Delete downloaded maps and rendered wallpapers; the next update fetches them again.
devMode.bypassCacheDesc: Read the schedule from GitHub and fetch the map live from Overpass, overwriting the cache. Off again after a restart.
devMode.resetTodayDesc: Delete today's guesses and turn Daily guess back on.
devMode.clearGuessDesc: Delete every day's guesses, the stats and the Daily guess setting.
devMode.guessFileDesc: guess.json: the game's history and the Daily guess setting.

update.notifyBody: New version {version} is available — open InkCity to update.
update.failed: Update failed. Please try again later.
